savollar.savol: "He said that..." qurilishi ingliz tilida qanday deb ataladi?
Direct Speech nima?
variantlar: Kimningdir so'zini o'z so'zlari bilan aytib berish
Kimningdir so'zini o'zgartirmasdan, aynan qo'shtirnoq ichida keltirish

savollar.savol: Indirect Speech (Reported Speech) nima?
variantlar: Kimningdir so'zini o'z so'zlari bilan, o'zgartirib qayta aytib berish

savollar.savol: Remember Box'da Mary qanday gap aytgan (Direct Speech)?
Indirect Speechda Mary haqida qanday deyilgan?
variantlar: Mary says she goes to Samarkand.
Mary said she is going to Samarkand today.
Mary said she will go to Samarkand.
Mary said (that) she was going to Samarkand that day.

savollar.savol: "We will do exercises" - bu qaysi turdagi nutq?
Reported speechda "will" fe'li qanday shaklga o'zgaradi?
Matndagi jurnalist (reporter) ismi nima?
Masudjon Sulaymonov qaysi tashkilotning xodimi?
Quyidagilardan qaysi biri O'zbekistondagi milliy gazeta nomi emas?
Reported speechda "today" so'zi odatda nimaga almashtiriladi?
"I am going to Samarkand today," dedi Mary. Buni to'g'ri Indirect Speechga o'giring.
variantlar: Mary said she will go to Samarkand today.
Mary said she goes to Samarkand that day.
Mary said (that) she was going to Samarkand that day.
Mary said she is going to Samarkand today.

savollar.savol: "We will do exercises," dedi ular. Indirect Speech shaklini tanlang.
variantlar: They said that they will do exercises.
They said that they would do exercises.
They said they are doing exercises.

savollar.savol: Jahongirning aytishicha, O'zbekistonda bosma gazetalar qaysi tillarda chop etiladi?
Yoshlar Ovozi gazetasi qachon tashkil topgan?
Yoshlar Ovozi elektron gazetasini qaysi ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda topish mumkin (Jahongir aytganicha)?
Xalqaro Hunarmandlar festivali qaysi kunlarda bo'lib o'tadi?
Xalqaro Hunarmandlar festivali qaysi shaharda o'tkaziladi?
Xokim Usmonovning aytishicha, festivalga necha davlatdan mehmon keladi?
Xokim Usmonovning aytishicha, necha davlatdan hunarmand (craftsmen) keladi?
Xokim Usmonov: "We're going to have International Handicrafters Festival..." dedi. Bu gapni to'g'ri Indirect Speechga o'giring.
variantlar: He said that they will have International Handicrafters Festival.
He said that they are going to have International Handicrafters Festival.
He said they have International Handicrafters Festival.
He said that they were going to have International Handicrafters Festival.

savollar.savol: Matn bo'yicha, mehmonlar necha ta madaniy joyga tashrif buyurishadi?
Xorijiy mehmonlar va ishtirokchilar necha ta ustaxonada (workshop) qatnashishadi?
Xalqaro Hunarmandchilik Tashkilotlaridan necha kishi tashrif buyuradi?
Matn ma'lumotlariga ko'ra, festivalga jami necha kishi (mehmon, hunarmand va tashkilot vakillari) tashrif buyuradi?
Xokim Usmonovning so'zlariga ko'ra, festivalning asosiy maqsadi nima?
variantlar: O'zbekistonning eski xalq san'ati an'analarini saqlash va rivojlantirishni ko'rsatish

savollar.savol: "They will visit 12 cultural places," dedi u. Buni Indirect Speechga to'g'ri o'giring.
variantlar: He said they visit 12 cultural places.
He said they visited 12 cultural places.
He said that they would visit 12 cultural places.
He said that they will visit 12 cultural places.

savollar.savol: Uzbekistan National News Agency qaysi xorijiy tillarda elektron gazeta chop etadi (Jahongir aytganicha)?
variantlar: Nemis, fransuz, xitoy va boshqa tillarda

savollar.savol: Jahongirning fikricha, Yoshlar Ovozi gazetasi nima uchun ahamiyatli?
variantlar: Chunki u yoshlar uchun haqiqiy media bo'lib, mamlakat va dunyodagi so'nggi voqealarni yoritadi
Chunki u faqat sport yangiliklarini beradi
